title: Escape arcs, regularity and semi-global solutions
source_hypothesis: Proper scalar classical operator of any real order satisfying P; every characteristic point over K lies in the interior of a compact regular semibicharacteristic interval with no characteristic endpoint over K.
component_scope: An escape arc carries information from outside a compact support to a characteristic point inside it. A rank-one arc uses quasi-concavity. A rank-two leaf uses the stronger minimum principle on its reduced complex surface. We prove the compact-support regularity conclusion with the actual endpoint geometry, then discharge the adjoint gain assumed in the preceding strict-loss lesson.
